subject: MIRT, STATA, and IRTPRO nominal response model results

messages.author: bb7e2f0dce60e95e
messages.subject: MIRT, STATA, and IRTPRO nominal response model results
parts:
Hi,

I replicated the nominal response model using the science data set prepared by Okan Bulut using MIRT at

https://rstudio-pubs-static.s3.amazonaws.com/357155_6674780326ef4afba5f009d17a85d4ae.html

and would like to ask a few questions about the MIRT results and how to compare the results to those of STATA and IRTPRO.

Q1.  Why are there four sets for the estimates of a and c while there are only three in the other two programs?  I think one category would serve as the reference.  If so, which category does MIRT use as the reference?

Q.2  Here are the MIRT results for the first item, Comfort:

                   a1              a2               a3              a4               c1               c2                  c3        
Comfort     0.2479192 -0.4393110 -0.3188852 0.5102770 -2.1664458 -0.28557185 1.8583455  

c4
0.5936722

Here are the STATA results for the same item:


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
             |      Coef.   Std. Err.      z    P>|z|     [95% Conf. Interval]
-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------
Comfort      |
     Discrim |
     2 vs 1  |   .7173123   .6735839     1.06   0.287    -.6028878    2.037512
     3 vs 1  |    .664262   .6455136     1.03   0.303    -.6009214    1.929445
     4 vs 1  |  -.2377281   .6516314    -0.36   0.715    -1.514902    1.039446
        Diff |
     2 vs 1  |  -2.675917   2.320612    -1.15   0.249    -7.224233      1.8724
     3 vs 1  |  -6.094149   5.590725    -1.09   0.276    -17.05177     4.86347
     4 vs 1  |   11.60947   33.00607     0.35   0.725    -53.08123    76.30017
-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------

The a's seem to be really different.  How would compare the c's to the Diff?

Q.3  I got this from IRTPRO

Original (Bock, 1972) Parameters, Nominal Items for Group 1, logit: (akθ + ck)   (Back to TOC)
Item Label Category 1 2 3 4
1 Comfort a 0.00 0.87 1.01 0.41
    c 0.00 1.32 -0.83 -2.69

Again they are very different.  Would anyone have experiences comparing the results from the two sets and could share their insights?  Thank you!

Regards,

Yue Hui.

messages.author: fce58c3d4618fa13
messages.subject: Re: MIRT, STATA, and IRTPRO nominal response model results
parts:
Hi,

seems to me like the programs use a different way of identifying the model through constraining the parameters. Stata and IRTPRO choose to constrain the first parameter to zero, while MIRT chooses to constrain their sum to zero, i.e., 0.2479192 - 0.4393110 - 0.3188852 + 0.5102770 = 0.
